title: Lessons from Hong Kong's High-rise Fire for Singapore's Review of Building (Strata Management) Act
what_it_is: Lessons from Hong Kong's High-rise Fire for Singapore's Review of Building (Strata Management) Act

sections.label: Wang Fuk Court fire review
sections.summary: Hong Kong is investigating the Wang Fuk Court fire while Singapore reviews learning points and may update the Building (Strata Management) Act.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Hong Kong authorities are still investigating the Wang Fuk Court fire incident.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Notwithstanding, the Government has been reviewing the learning points based on the early observations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Where relevant, the Ministry of National Development will incorporate findings from the review into our legislative and policy framework, including the Building (Strata Management) Act.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: When reviewing the Building (Strata Management) Act, we will be looking at the powers of the Management Corporation Strata Title.
